sentences.zh: 每一个看着我并根据我对自己能力的评估来决定自己能做成什么的年轻有色人种。

sentences.en: So Allison, you say that this response is a masterclass in how to think about warmth and assertiveness.
sentences.zh: 所以艾莉森，你说这段回应堪称如何思考热情与强势的教科书级范例。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 为什么这么说？

sentences.en: So she's asked a direct question.
sentences.zh: 所以当她被问到一个直接的问题时。

sentences.en: And in situations like this, many people might feel like they want to deflect.
sentences.zh: 在这样的情况下，许多人可能会觉得想要搪塞过去。

sentences.en: They don't want to self-promote.
sentences.zh: 他们不想自我宣传。

sentences.en: They don't want to come across as being overly ambitious or self-aggrandizing.
sentences.zh: 他们不想显得过于野心勃勃或自我吹嘘。

sentences.en: But she essentially has a two-sentence response.
sentences.zh: 但她基本上只用两句话就回答完了。

sentences.en: It is not long.
sentences.zh: 并不长。

sentences.en: But the first sentence hits on assertiveness.
sentences.zh: 但第一句话切中了果断。

sentences.en: And the second sentence hits on warmth.
sentences.zh: 而第二句话切中了温暖。

sentences.en: Is this my ambition to be the president of the United States?
sentences.zh: 这是我想成为美国总统的野心吗？

sentences.en: It's absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Sounds pretty assertive.
sentences.zh: 听起来非常果断。

sentences.en: The second one, I have a responsibility to answer that question because I'm a role model for other people.
sentences.zh: 第二句，我肩负着回答这个问题的责任，因为我是其他人的榜样。

sentences.en: And in that, she is saying I care about other people.
sentences.zh: 在这其中，她在表达我关心其他人。

sentences.en: So what I think about this that is brilliant is that she didn't lead with this information.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这非常高明的一点是，她并没有一开始就抛出这些信息。

sentences.en: She was asked a question.
sentences.zh: 她只是被问了一个问题。

sentences.en: But when she had an opportunity to put something out into the world that originated with her, she had a two-sentence response that put out, I am assertive and I am warm.
sentences.zh: 但当她有机会向世人展现源自她自己的东西时，她的两句话传达出：我很果断，我也很温暖。

sentences.en: People like Stacey, I've become more aware of thinking about at any given moment, there are multiple truths.
sentences.zh: 像斯泰西这样的人，我越来越意识到在任何特定时刻，都存在着多种真相。

sentences.en: And what's my goal in this interaction?
sentences.zh: 我在这次互动中的目标是什么？

sentences.en: You may not want to run for the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 你可能并不想竞选美国总统。

sentences.en: You may never end up on a CBS national show.
sentences.zh: 你可能永远也不会上哥伦比亚广播公司的全国节目。

sentences.en: But you get a million opportunities to be interviewed every single day.
sentences.zh: 但你每天都有无数次被采访的机会。

sentences.en: Every time someone says, how are you?
sentences.zh: 每次当有人问，你好吗？

sentences.en: How's work?
sentences.zh: 工作怎么样？

sentences.en: What's up?
sentences.zh: 最近在忙什么？

sentences.en: Those are opportunities to tell a story.
sentences.zh: 这些都是讲述故事的机会。

sentences.en: And I think what's a good example of what she did is someone gave her an opportunity and she didn't waste it.
sentences.zh: 我认为她做得很好的一点是，当别人给她机会时，她没有浪费。

sentences.en: Allison Fregale is an organizational psychologist at the University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森·弗雷加莱是北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的组织心理学家。

sentences.en: She's the author of Likeable Badass, How Women Get the Success They Deserve.
sentences.zh: 她是《可爱女硬汉：女性如何赢得应得的成功》一书的作者。

sentences.en: Allison, thank you so much for joining me today on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森，非常感谢你今天来到《隐秘大脑》节目。

sentences.en: It is such a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这真的是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: So happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.zh: 塔拉·博伊尔是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.zh: 我是《隐秘大脑》的执行编辑。

sentences.zh: 最后，我们以我们的姊妹播客《我无名英雄》中的一个故事来结束今天的节目。

sentences.zh: 本期《我无名英雄》板块由T-Mobile企业业务赞助播出。

sentences.en: Today's story comes from Molly Baker.
sentences.zh: 今天的故事来自莫莉·贝克。

sentences.en: In March of 2018, Molly lost her husband, Marlon, in a skiing accident.
sentences.zh: 2018年3月，莫莉在一次滑雪事故中失去了丈夫马龙。

sentences.en: In the first few weeks after his death, her community provided a lot of support.
sentences.zh: 在他去世后的最初几周里，她所在的社区给予了大量的支持。

sentences.en: But after a while, the cards and meals started to slow down.
sentences.zh: 但过了一段时间，慰问卡片和送餐开始减少了。

sentences.en: People have, you know, families come into town and families left.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们的亲友来了又走。

sentences.en: People have to get back to their jobs.
sentences.zh: 人们必须回到各自的工作岗位。

sentences.en: People have to get back to their normal life.
sentences.zh: 人们必须回到正常生活中去。

sentences.en: And so things kind of drop off.
sentences.zh: 所以事情就渐渐冷清下来了。

sentences.en: I had a dear friend of mine, Carla Vale, who came up with this idea that maybe she could set up a calendar of sorts that would assign people a particular day.
sentences.zh: 我有一位挚友卡拉·韦尔，她想出了这样一个主意：也许她可以建立某种日历，为每个人分配一个特定的日子。

sentences.en: And what that looked like for them was that on that day, they would reach out to me in some tangible way, maybe via text, maybe a phone call, maybe a card.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这意味着在那一天，他们会以某种切实的方式联系我，也许是通过短信，也许是一个电话，或者一张卡片。

sentences.en: They would drop off a card.
sentences.zh: 他们会送来一张卡片。

sentences.en: Maybe they would drop some chocolates or something off on my door.
sentences.zh: 也许他们会在我的门前放一些巧克力或别的东西。

sentences.en: It didn't have to be anything big.
sentences.zh: 不需要是什么大事。

sentences.en: And then also, for me, I could look at the calendar.
sentences.zh: 然后对我来说，我也可以查看日历。

sentences.en: I was given the names.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了名单。

sentences.en: And so I could look at the calendar and be like, oh, it's the 6th today and so-and-so's assigned.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以查看日历，心想，哦，今天是6号，轮到某某某了。

sentences.en: And I could reach out to them as well if I needed some emotional support or just needed something.
sentences.zh: 如果我需要一些情感支持或者只是需要什么帮助，我也可以联系他们。

sentences.en: Like maybe I needed them to run an errand for me or, you know, if that was possible.
sentences.zh: 比如也许我需要他们帮我跑腿，你知道的，如果可行的话。

sentences.en: So it worked both ways.
sentences.zh: 所以这起到了双向的作用。

sentences.en: A lot of people are really, really uncomfortable around grief and loss.
sentences.zh: 很多人面对悲伤和失落时会感到非常非常不自在。

sentences.en: And so what they do is instead of doing something, they just do nothing and they don't say anything.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的做法是，与其做点什么，不如什么都不做，什么也不说。

sentences.en: And that's the worSt.
sentences.zh: 而这才是最糟糕的。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我是说，

sentences.en: I remember going to the grocery store and I would see someone in the distance that they would know me and they would literally turn around and walk the other direction because they were so uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我记得我去杂货店时，会在远处看到一个认识我的人，他们甚至会直接转身朝另一个方向走去，因为他们太不自在了。

sentences.en: They were so uncomfortable with my loss that they didn't know what to say to me.
sentences.zh: 他们对我的丧亲之痛感到如此不自在，以至于不知道该对我说什么。

sentences.en: So that's why it was nice to have that calendar set up so that that was tangible, like, oh, you could send a text, you could do this, you could do that.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么拥有这样一个日历会很好，因为它是具体的，比如，哦，你可以发条短信，你可以这样做，你可以那样做。

sentences.en: Some ideas of tangible ways was very helpful.
sentences.zh: 提供一些具体做法的建议非常有帮助。

sentences.en: I love that Carla did this.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸卡拉做了这件事。

sentences.en: And it was a way that she was able to use her unique gifts to help other people love on me.
sentences.zh: 这成了她发挥自己独特天赋、帮助其他人来关爱我的一种方式。

sentences.en: And I will always be grateful, forever grateful for that year in my life.
sentences.zh: 我将永远、永远感激我生命中的那一年。

sentences.zh: 莫莉·贝克住在华盛顿州萨马米什。
